title: Template programs
statement: For a finite binary Turing machine $M$, each template is assigned a list of micro-operations on eleven registers. The preamble encodes the two constant gates false and true; a zero-guard template encodes its specified constant gate; and the dummy template encodes a list of $W_d$ false constant gates, where $W_d$ is the fixed table width for $M$. The final template prints a delimiter, the linear encoding of the current snapshot at position $	ext{snapWidth}(M)$, and another delimiter; every other template is assigned the instruction micro-operations associated with that template.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
the input is a template for the number of work tapes of $M$
